query:
SELECT
                u.uuid as "sender_uuid!",
                u.username as "sender_username!",
                u.name as sender_name,
                ua.hash as sender_avatar_hash,
                ua.mime_type as sender_avatar_mime,
                COUNT(pm.uuid)::bigint as "unread_count!"
            FROM chat.private_messages pm
            JOIN users u ON pm.from_user_id = u.id
            LEFT JOIN user_avatars ua ON u.id = ua.user_id
            WHERE pm.to_user_id = $1
              AND pm.read_at IS NULL
            GROUP BY u.uuid, u.username, u.name, ua.hash, ua.mime_type
            ORDER BY MAX(pm.created_at) DESC
